legend.pass: every data page meets the check
legend.partial: some data pages meet the check, some do not
legend.fail: no data page meets the check

footnote: A check is pass where every one of an agency's data pages meets it, fail where none do, and partial where some do and some do not; a page that returned an access denial, an unconfirmable absence or a server error is counted as not meeting the check, and an agency with one data page can only pass or fail. The fix under a check is the action for the failing outcome the most agencies hit on that check across this measurement. Measured across all sixteen federal statistical agencies in October 2026.
